title: Realize a prescribed finite Galois automorphism as a unique Frobenius
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ and let E be an intermediate field of Ω/ℚ that is finite-dimensional and Galois over ℚ. For every g ∈ Autℚ(E) and finite set B ⊆ ℕ, there exist a natural prime ℓ ∉ B and a valuation subring V of E such that ℓ is a nonunit of V, g preserves V and induces the ℓ-power map on its residue field, and every rational automorphism g′ of E having that same Frobenius property at V equals g.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (g : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) (B : Finset ℕ), ∃ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ ∉ B ∧ ∃ V : ValuationSubring E, V.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ V.IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ ∧ ∀ g' : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, V.IsFrobeniusAt g' ℓ → g' = g
